content.text: Which statement best describes the scene? Choices:  A. There are 7 pieces of chicken in a pan. 4 are roughly in a row, and 3 are scattered above them. On average, the bottom pieces look a bit more cooked than the top ones. B. There are 6 pieces of chicken in a pan. 3 are roughly in a row, and 3 are scattered above them. On average, the bottom pieces look a bit more cooked than the top ones. C. There are 7 pieces of chicken in a pan. 4 are roughly in a row, and 3 are scattered above them. On average, the top pieces look a bit more cooked than the bottom ones. D. There are 6 pieces of chicken in a pan. 3 are roughly in a row, and 3 are scattered above them. On average, the top pieces look a bit more cooked than the bottom ones. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
